name: cAMP responsive element binding protein 1

function.text: CREB1 encodes cyclic AMP-responsive element-binding protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in signal transduction and cAMP/PKA signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Clear cell odontogenic carcinoma; Primary pulmonary myxoid sarcoma; Clear cell sarcoma of soft tissue. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
